content: {"phoneNote":"The hero reads well, but the page repeats the address and 'Navodila za pot' five times and leaves a dead band between the illustration and the '2006' block.","desktopNote":"The hero is clean, yet the 'Obiščite nas' section directly duplicates the dark contact block above it and large empty bands sit under the hero and beside 'Kje delamo'.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the 'Obiščite nas' section and the hero/footer duplicates so address, phone and directions appear once in the dark contact block plus the footer legal line.","Tighten vertical rhythm: close the gap after the hero illustration (phone) and under the hero (desktop), and shrink the giant '2006' to the size of the section headings.","Vary the service list and 'Kje delamo': distinct icons per service and a small map or region list instead of square markers on bare rules; fill the empty right half on desktop."],"blockers":["Desktop and phone, after the dark contact section: 'Obiščite nas' repeats the same address and directions link that were shown a few hundred pixels above.","Desktop whole page, hero: the sticky header overlays and clips the second headline line 'za vašo hišo' when scrolled — verify header behaviour."]}
